name: MCP Server for Trading Indicators and Workflows

mentions.name: MCP Server for Trading Indicators and Workflows
mentions.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI coding agents such as Codex or Claude Code edit the trading system's indicators and workflows and set up monitors. It replaces an earlier Copilot-based assistant that relied on costly API keys, using subscription-backed AI access via MCP for much lower cost.
mentions.audience: Personal use; the author built it to have AI coding agents set up and edit their own trading workflows.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently working on a MCP that let Codex or Claude Code be able to edit indicators and workflows, as well as setting up monitors for me. I originally made a Copilot system for this but it's too expensive since it uses API keys to access AI services, would be much cheaper with subscription backed access via MCP :D
mentions.author: BruzWJ
